en.quote: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD do sanctify him.

en.15: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD do sanctify him.
en.16: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
en.17: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.
